chapter.li: LEChapter15 Verse1 And now it came to pass that when Jesus had ended these sayings, he cast his eyes round about on the multitude and said unto them, Behold, 2PP ye have heard the things which I have taught before I ascended to my Father. Therefore, whoso remembereth these sayings of mine and doeth them, him will I raise up at the last day. VerseEnd

Verse2 And it came to pass that when Jesus had said these words, he perceived that there were some among them who marveled, and wondered what he would concerning the law of Moses, for they understood not the saying that old things had passed away and that all things had become new. VerseEnd Verse3 And he said unto them, Marvel not that I said unto 2PP you that old things had passed away and that all things had become new. VerseEnd Verse4 Behold, I say unto 2PP you that the law is fulfilled that was given unto Moses. VerseEnd Verse5 Behold, I am he that gave the law, and I am he who covenanted with my people Israel. Therefore, the law in me is fulfilled, for I have come to fulfill the law; therefore, it hath an end. VerseEnd Verse6 Behold, I do not destroy the prophets, for as many as have not been fulfilled in me, verily I say unto 2PP you, shall all be fulfilled. VerseEnd Verse7 And because I said unto 2PP you that old things hath passed away, I do not destroy that which hath been spoken concerning things which are to come. VerseEnd Verse8 For behold, the covenant which I have made with my people is not all fulfilled, but the law which was given unto Moses hath an end in me. VerseEnd Verse9 Behold, I am the law and the light. Look unto me and endure to the end and 2PP ye shall live; for unto him that endureth to the end will I give eternal life. VerseEnd Verse10 Behold, I have given unto 2PP you the commandments; therefore, keep my commandments. And this is the law and the prophets, for they truly testified of me. VerseEnd

Verse11 And now it came to pass that when Jesus had spoken these words, he said unto those twelve whom he had chosen, VerseEnd Verse12 2PP Ye are my disciples, and 2PP ye are a light unto this people, who are a remnant of the house of Joseph. VerseEnd Verse13 And behold, this is the land of 2PP your inheritance, and the Father hath given it unto 2PP you. VerseEnd Verse14 And not at any time hath the Father given me commandment that I should tell it unto 2PP your brethren at Jerusalem; VerseEnd Verse15 neither at any time hath the Father given me commandment that I should tell unto them concerning the other tribes of the house of Israel whom the Father hath led away out of the land. VerseEnd Verse16 This much did the Father command me that I should tell unto them, VerseEnd Verse17 that other sheep I have which are not of this fold; them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice, and there shall be one fold and one shepherd. VerseEnd Verse18 And now because of stiffneckedness and unbelief, they understood not my word; therefore, I was commanded to say no more, of the Father, concerning this thing unto them. VerseEnd Verse19 But verily I say unto 2PP you that the Father hath commanded me, and I tell it unto 2PP you, that 2PP ye were separated from among them because of their iniquity; therefore, it is because of their iniquity that they know not of 2PP you. VerseEnd Verse20 And verily I say unto 2PP you again that the other tribes hath the Father separated from them, and it is because of their iniquity that they know not of them. VerseEnd Verse21 And verily I say unto 2PP you that 2PP ye are they of whom I said, Other sheep I have, which are not of this fold; them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice, and there shall be one fold and one shepherd. VerseEnd Verse22 And they understood me not, for they supposed it had been the gentiles; for they understood not that the gentiles should be converted through their preaching. VerseEnd Verse23 And they understood me not, that I said, They shall hear my voice, and they understood me not that the gentiles should not at that time hear my voice, that I should not manifest myself unto them save it were by the holy ghost. VerseEnd Verse24 But behold, 2PP ye have both heard my voice and seen me, and 2PP ye are my sheep, and 2PP ye are numbered among those whom the Father hath given me. VerseEnd LEChapter16 Verse1 And verily, verily I say unto 2PP you that I have other sheep which are not of this land, neither of the land of Jerusalem, neither in any parts of that land round about whither I have been to minister. VerseEnd Verse2 For they of whom I speak are they who have not as yet heard my voice, neither have I at any time manifested myself unto them. VerseEnd Verse3 But I have received a commandment of the Father that I shall go unto them, and that they shall hear my voice and shall be numbered among my sheep, that there may be one fold and one shepherd; therefore, I go to shew myself unto them. VerseEnd

Verse4 And I command 2PP you that 2PP ye shall write these sayings after I am gone, that if it so be that my people at Jerusalem — they who have seen me and been with me in my ministry — do not ask the Father in my name that they may receive a knowledge of 2PP you by the holy ghost, and also of the other tribes whom they know not of, that these sayings which 2PP ye shall write shall be kept and shall be manifested unto the gentiles; that through the fullness of the gentiles, the remnant of their seed, who shall be scattered forth upon the face of the earth because of their unbelief, may be brought in, or may be brought to a knowledge of me, their Redeemer. VerseEnd Verse5 And then will I gather them in from the four quarters of the earth, and then will I fulfill the covenant which the Father hath made unto all the people of the house of Israel. VerseEnd Verse6 And blessed are the gentiles because of their belief in me, in and of the holy ghost, which witness unto them of me and of the Father. VerseEnd Verse7 Behold, because of their belief in me, saith the Father, and because of the unbelief of 2PP you, O house of Israel, in the latter day shall the truth come unto the gentiles, that the fullness of these things shall be made known unto them. VerseEnd

Verse8 But woe, saith the Father, unto the unbelieving of the gentiles, for — notwithstanding that they have come forth upon the face of this land, and have scattered my people who are of the house of Israel, and my people who are of the house of Israel have been cast out from among them and have been trodden under feet by them; VerseEnd Verse9 and because of the mercies of the Father unto the gentiles, and also the judgments of the Father upon my people who are of the house of Israel — verily, verily I say unto 2PP you that after all this — and I have caused my people who are of the house of Israel to be smitten, and to be afflicted, and to be slain, and to be cast out from among them, and to become hated by them, and to become a hiss and a byword among them — VerseEnd Verse10 and, thus commandeth the Father that I should say unto 2PP you: At that day when the gentiles shall sin against my gospel, and shall reject the fullness of my gospel, and shall be lifted up in the pride of their hearts above all nations and above all the people of the whole earth, and shall be filled with all manner of lyings, and of deceits, and of mischiefs, and all manner of hypocrisy, and murders, and priestcrafts, and whoredoms, and of secret abominations, and if they shall do all these things, and shall reject the fullness of my gospel, Behold, saith the Father, I will bring the fullness of my gospel from among them. VerseEnd Verse11 And then will I remember my covenant which I have made unto my people, O house of Israel, and I will bring my gospel unto them. VerseEnd Verse12 And I will shew unto 2PSI thee, O house of Israel, that the gentiles shall not have power over 2PP you, but I will remember my covenant unto 2PP you, O house of Israel, and 2PP ye shall come unto the knowledge of the fullness of my gospel. VerseEnd Verse13 But if the gentiles will repent and return unto me, saith the Father, behold, they shall be numbered among my people, O house of Israel. VerseEnd Verse14 And I will not suffer my people who are of the house of Israel to go through among them and tread them down, saith the Father. VerseEnd Verse15 But if they will not turn unto me and hearken unto my voice, I will suffer them — yea, I will suffer my people, O house of Israel — that they shall go through among them and shall tread them down and they shall be as salt that hath lost its savor, which is thenceforth good for nothing but to be cast out and to be trodden underfoot of my people, O house of Israel. VerseEnd

Verse16 Verily, verily I say unto 2PP you, thus has the Father commanded me, that I should give unto this people this land for their inheritance, VerseEnd Verse17 and when the words of the prophet Isaiah shall be fulfilled, which say: VerseEnd Verse18 2PSI Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice, with the voice together shall they sing, for they shall see eye to eye when the Lord shall bring again Zion. VerseEnd Verse19 Break forth into joy, sing together 2PP ye waste places of Jerusalem, for the Lord hath comforted his people, he hath redeemed Jerusalem. VerseEnd Verse20 The Lord hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of God. VerseEnd
